tips.planFirst: you can ask /brainstorm to shape requirements before writing code?
tips.mentionFiles: you can @mention files so the agent reads the exact code you mean?
tips.slashSkills: you can type / to run skills like /builder, /code-reviewer, and /plan-reviewer?
tips.dragScope: you can drag files or diffs into the composer to scope a change?
tips.subagents: you can delegate independent tasks to sub-agents running in parallel?
tips.explore: you can use /explore to research unfamiliar parts of the codebase?
tips.codeReview: you can run /code-reviewer on your changes before merging?
tips.planReview: you can run /plan-reviewer on your plan before implementing?
tips.thinkingLevel: you can raise the thinking level for hard problems and lower it for quick tasks?
tips.compact: you can compact the context when a long session starts to drag?
tips.voice: you can use voice input to prompt hands-free?
tips.history: you can resume past work from session history?
tips.usage: you can keep token spend in view via the usage summary?
tips.modelSwitch: you can switch models in the bottom bar to balance speed and quality?
tips.splitPane: you can open sub-agent results in a split pane to compare?
tips.pasteBlock: you can paste multi-line code — it becomes an attachment with full context?
tips.followUp: you can follow up in the same thread — the agent remembers the whole conversation?
tips.failingTest: you can point at a failing test and ask for the root cause before the fix?

voice.unavailableStarting: Voice input is not available while the agent session is starting.
